name: Nagase India pvt ltd
india_angle: Nagase India has been present in India for over 60 years, evolving from a liaison office to a private limited company, focusing on customer needs.
summary: Nagase India Pvt Ltd is involved in the supply of specialty chemicals and materials relevant to the semiconductor industry, including photoresist materials and plating chemicals. They cater to various industries such as automotive and electronics, leveraging their global network and expertise in chemical solutions.
